$comment: Stills, generated by scripts/stills.mjs through OpenRouter. Two kinds, and the
role: input   The source media a mode actually takes — a first frame, a last frame,
keyframes, reference images. These are durable: once the video pipeline
is unblocked they become the real inputs we feed LTX-2 image-to-video,
first/last-frame and reference endpoints, so the demos are honest end
to end rather than a text prompt pretending to be an image job.
role: poster  A holding frame for a mode tile while video generation is blocked.
Interim only: the video pipeline cuts its own poster from a real frame,
and these are replaced the moment clips exist. Never labelled as video.
Nothing here is network output and nothing carries a certificate; src/lib/reel.ts
Style is fixed in scripts/stills.mjs so every still shares the site's palette; keep
prompts about subject and light, not about grade.

stills.prompt: a still harbour at dawn, fishing boats at their moorings, mist lifting off flat water, a distant headland, nobody in shot
stills.alt: A still harbour at dawn, boats at their moorings, mist on the water.

stills.prompt: a single gull settled on a weathered wooden harbour post, wings folded, the sea soft and out of focus behind it
stills.alt: A gull settled on a weathered harbour post, sea blurred behind.

stills.alt: An empty beach under a calm pale sky.
